title: Non-text Content
body: All non-text content that is presented to the user has a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose. Images that convey meaning need alt text; decorative images need an empty alt.

title: Info and Relationships
body: Information, structure and relationships conveyed through presentation can be programmatically determined or are available in text. Headings, lists and table headers must be marked up, not only styled.

title: Contrast (Minimum)
body: Visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, except for large text, which needs at least 3:1. Large text is 18 point or 14 point bold. Ratios are not rounded before comparison.

title: Resize Text
body: Text can be resized without assistive technology up to 200 percent without loss of content or functionality. Layouts that break when the user zooms fail this criterion.

title: Non-text Contrast
body: Visual information required to identify user interface components and states has a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against adjacent colours. Borders, icons and focus rings are covered.

title: Link Purpose (In Context)
body: The purpose of each link can be determined from the link text alone or from the link text together with its programmatically determined context.

title: Focus Visible
body: Any keyboard-operable user interface has a mode of operation where the keyboard focus indicator is visible. Removing the outline without a replacement fails this criterion.

title: Target Size (Minimum)
body: The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, except where the target is inline in a sentence or has sufficient spacing. Measured sizes are compared unrounded.

title: Language of Page
body: The default human language of each web page can be programmatically determined, for example through the lang attribute on the html element.

title: Labels or Instructions
body: Labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input. Every form control needs a programmatically associated label, not only a placeholder.

title: Name, Role, Value
body: For all user interface components, the name and role can be programmatically determined; states, properties and values can be set by the user and are exposed to assistive technology.

title: Interactive target is smaller than 24 by 24 CSS pixels
body: A pointer target measures less than the 24 by 24 CSS pixel minimum from WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8. Touch users with tremor or large fingers miss it, and the miss costs a conversion.
suggested_fix: Increase the target to at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, or add 24 pixels of spacing around it.

title: Translucent text falls below the contrast minimum
body: The measured pair uses alpha, and the composited colour is below the threshold for its size. The rendered colour is what the criterion applies to, not the declared one.
suggested_fix: Raise the text opacity or darken the colour until the composited pair reaches the threshold.

title: Page declares no canonical URL
body: Without a canonical link, the same content reachable through several URLs competes with itself in search results and link equity is split.
suggested_fix: Add a canonical link pointing at the preferred absolute URL of this page.

title: Meta description length is outside the useful range
body: A meta description shorter than 120 characters leaves room unused, and one longer than 160 is truncated in results. The measured length comes from the DOM snapshot.
suggested_fix: Rewrite the description to 120 to 160 characters that state the page offer.

title: Heading levels skip a level
body: The heading outline jumps by more than one level, which flattens the document structure for search engines and for assistive technology that navigates by heading.
suggested_fix: Renumber the headings so each level follows the previous one without gaps.

title: No Content-Security-Policy header
body: Without a CSP the browser executes any script an injected payload can place on the page. The header is absent from the response, which is a passive observation, not a penetration test.
suggested_fix: Serve a Content-Security-Policy that starts from default-src 'self' and allows only the origins the page needs.

title: No Strict-Transport-Security header
body: Without HSTS the first request of a session can be downgraded to plain HTTP, and the user cannot tell. The header is absent from the response.
suggested_fix: Send Strict-Transport-Security with max-age of at least one year on HTTPS responses.

title: No X-Content-Type-Options header
body: Without nosniff, a browser may guess a different content type than the server declares, which turns an uploaded file into an executable script.
suggested_fix: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on every response.

title: Page can be framed by another origin
body: Neither X-Frame-Options nor frame-ancestors restricts framing, so the page can be embedded in a clickjacking overlay.
suggested_fix: Send X-Frame-Options: DENY, or a CSP frame-ancestors directive that names the allowed parents.

title: No Referrer-Policy header
body: Without a referrer policy the full URL of the page is sent to third parties in the Referer header, which can leak identifiers that appear in the path.
suggested_fix: Send Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

title: Largest Contentful Paint is above 2.5 seconds
body: The largest content element paints after the good threshold of 2.5 seconds. The number comes from a lab measurement at this viewport, not from field data.
suggested_fix: Reduce the bytes and priority of the largest element, or serve it from a faster origin.

title: Cumulative Layout Shift is above 0.1
body: Content moves after it is first painted. The value is the largest session window from the lab measurement at this viewport.
suggested_fix: Reserve space for images, embeds and dynamic content so nothing moves after paint.

title: Total Blocking Time is above 200 milliseconds
body: Long tasks after the first paint block input. The number is measured between the first contentful paint and the end of the measurement window.
suggested_fix: Split long scripts, defer non-critical work, and move heavy computation off the main thread.

title: Time to first byte is above 800 milliseconds
body: The server takes long to send the first byte of the document, so every later milestone starts late.
suggested_fix: Cache the document at the edge, or reduce the work the origin does before responding.

title: Document is wider than the viewport
body: The page scrolls sideways at this viewport because an element extends past the right edge. Horizontal scrolling on a phone hides content and causes mis-taps.
suggested_fix: Constrain the offending element with max-width, or let it wrap instead of forcing a fixed width.

title: Interactive element is covered at its centre
body: A hit test at the centre of an interactive element returns a different element, so a pointer cannot activate it. The measurement is geometric, not a guess about appearance.
suggested_fix: Move the covering element, or raise the target's stacking order so its centre is clickable.

title: Screenshot was clipped at the height cap
body: The page is taller than the screenshot cap, so the capture covers the top of the document only. Visual review below the cap is impossible for this run.
suggested_fix: Review the remaining height in a separate capture, or reduce the page height.

title: Element overflows the viewport horizontally
body: An element's right edge lies outside the viewport at this width, which is the visual cause of horizontal scrolling.
suggested_fix: Fix the width of the element, or allow it to shrink inside its container.

title: Primary action is not clickable where it looks clickable
body: The hit test shows another element on top of the action's centre. A user who taps the button triggers the wrong thing or nothing.
suggested_fix: Remove the overlay from the action's area, or give the action a higher stacking order.

title: Small targets are crowded together
body: Several interactive targets are smaller than the comfortable minimum at this viewport, so mis-taps are likely even when each one technically passes.
suggested_fix: Increase target size and spacing so adjacent actions are not ambiguous.

title: Conversion action cannot be activated
body: The primary call to action is covered at its centre, so the page cannot convert anyone who reaches it. This is a geometric fact from the hit test, not an opinion about design.
suggested_fix: Make the action's centre clickable by removing or reordering the covering element.

title: Form control is too small to hit reliably
body: A form control measures less than 24 by 24 CSS pixels at this viewport, which adds friction at the exact step where the user decides to convert.
suggested_fix: Increase the control height to at least 44 pixels on touch viewports.

title: First contentful paint is slower than two seconds
body: Nothing visible paints for more than two seconds at this viewport. Visitors who see a blank screen leave before the offer appears.
suggested_fix: Inline the critical CSS and reduce blocking requests before the first paint.
